BenefitUnlimitedComponent.bdBenefitUnlimitedDescription: Dental X-Rays are covered every 12 to 36 months, depending on the procedure.
Fillings are limited to coverage once every 2 years per surface per tooth. Crowns are limited to coverage once every 5 years per tooth.
Periodontics are covered every 6 to 36 months.
Extractions are unlimited. Oroantral fistula closure is covered once every 60 months.
1 palliative treatment every 12 months. 1 consultation, every 6 months. 2 teledentistry every calendar year. Other services covered as needed.
